docs.title: openalex-snapshot Documentation
docs.text:
This folder contains internet-facing documentation for openalex-snapshot.

Argument precedence (highest wins): CLI arguments > config subcommand section > config defaults section > built-in defaults.

Recommended page order:

  1. quickstart.md
  2. commands/check.md
  3. commands/config.md

docs.title: Build
docs.text:
cd openalex-snapshot
cargo build --release
./target/release/openalex-snapshot --help

docs.title: Preflight
docs.text:
./target/release/openalex-snapshot check \
  --root-dir /Volumes/openalex \
  --dataset all

docs.title: Convert snapshot to parquet
docs.text:
./target/release/openalex-snapshot convert \
  --root-dir /Volumes/openalex \
  --dataset works \
  --profile balanced

docs.title: Verify output
docs.text:
./target/release/openalex-snapshot verify_convert \
  --root-dir /Volumes/openalex \
  --dataset works \
  --scope dataset \
  --metadata-level both

docs.title: Build and verify index
docs.text:
./target/release/openalex-snapshot index \
  --root-dir /Volumes/openalex \
  --dataset works

./target/release/openalex-snapshot verify_index \
  --root-dir /Volumes/openalex \
  --dataset works

docs.title: Extract by IDs
docs.text:
./target/release/openalex-snapshot extract \
  --root-dir /Volumes/openalex \
  --ids /Volumes/openalex/ids.csv \
  --output /Volumes/openalex/extract.parquet

docs.title: Download and verify snapshot
docs.text:
./target/release/openalex-snapshot download --root-dir /Volumes/openalex
./target/release/openalex-snapshot verify_download --root-dir /Volumes/openalex

docs.title: Repair failed files from verify report
docs.text:
./target/release/openalex-snapshot repair_convert \
  --root-dir /Volumes/openalex \
  --from-verify-report /Volumes/openalex/.openalex-snapshot_metadata/reports/verify_convert-123456.json

docs.title: Out of memory in convert
docs.text:
Use:

  • --profile safe
  • --workers 1
  • explicit --max-memory-mb

If needed, convert datasets and files in smaller units.

docs.title: Verify appears to slow down over time
docs.text: Expected when remaining files are larger and id-hash is enabled. Progress is item-based, not byte-based.

docs.title: Mixed old/new metadata folders
docs.text:
Current canonical location is:

  • .openalex-snapshot_metadata/

Expected structure:

  • .openalex-snapshot_metadata/reports
  • .openalex-snapshot_metadata/download/{manifests,logs,reports}
  • .openalex-snapshot_metadata/datasets/<dataset>/{schemata,verify,logs,reports}

docs.title: Schema errors around nested types
docs.text:
Ensure canonical schema cache exists:

  • .<dataset>_metadata/schemata/unified_schema.csv

If stale, re-run with schema refresh options.

docs.title: Command: index
docs.text:
Build a parquet lookup index equivalent to R build_corpus_index().

Default dataset is all (build indexes for all datasets). Use --dataset <name> to limit to one dataset. When running with --dataset all, existing per-dataset index files are skipped and missing ones are built. If --index-file is supplied, it is ignored in all mode.

docs.title: Usage
docs.text:
openalex-snapshot index \
  --root-dir /data \
  --dataset works \
  --profile balanced

docs.title: Output columns
docs.text:
• id
  • id_block
  • parquet_file
  • file_row_number

docs.title: Profile / tuning
docs.text:
--profile controls the DuckDB memory budget per worker (derived from 80% of usable RAM, clamped to a range). Only safe also caps the worker count.

Profile Workers cap Memory fraction Memory range safe max 2 15% of usable RAM 1 – 8 GiB balanced (none) 35% of usable RAM 4 – 24 GiB fast (none) 55% of usable RAM 8 – 32 GiB

Fallback when RAM cannot be detected: safe=2 GiB, balanced=6 GiB, fast=12 GiB.

Use --max-memory-mb to override the profile memory calculation entirely. Workers set via --workers or config are respected unless safe clamps them.

docs.title: Command: all
docs.text: Run the full pipeline from config with a bounded verify_convert/repair_convert retry loop.

docs.title: Usage
docs.text: openalex-snapshot all --config ./openalex-snapshot.yaml --retry 2

docs.title: Flow
docs.text:
1. check (if enabled)
  2. download (if enabled)
  3. verify_download (if enabled)
  4. convert
  5. verify_convert
  6. repair_convert (only when verify fails, up to --retry)
  7. index
  8. verify_index

docs.title: check
docs.text: Run environment and capacity preflight checks before heavy operations.

docs.title: Usage
docs.text: openalex-snapshot check --root-dir . --dataset all

docs.title: What it checks
docs.text:
• dependency binaries (duckdb, aws)
  • path writability for root/snapshot/parquet/metadata
  • download disk requirement (remote manifest + safety margin)
  • convert disk requirement (precise source inventory estimate)
  • memory/tuning risk based on profile/workers/memory settings

docs.title: Options
docs.text:
• --strict fail on warnings as well as failures
  • --json machine-readable output
  • --precise enable precise source inventory estimate
  • shared runtime args: --dataset, --profile, --workers, --max-memory-mb

docs.title: Command: config
docs.text: Create or verify openalex-snapshot YAML config files.

docs.title: Usage
docs.text:
openalex-snapshot config --create complete
openalex-snapshot config --create safe --config ./openalex-snapshot-safe.yaml
openalex-snapshot config --verify --config ./openalex-snapshot.yaml

docs.title: Notes
docs.text:
• --create templates: complete (default), safe, fast
  • precedence: CLI > command section > defaults section > built-in defaults
  • --verify fails on unknown keys or wrong types

docs.title: Command: convert
docs.text: Convert OpenAlex snapshot .json.gz files into parquet while preserving relative structure.

docs.title: Usage
docs.text:
openalex-snapshot convert \
  --root-dir /data \
  --dataset works \
  --profile safe \
  --workers 1

docs.title: Key behavior
docs.text:
• 1 input .gz maps to 1 output .parquet
  • resume-safe output skipping
  • verification is separate via verify_convert
  • supports selected-file conversion via repeated --input-file

docs.title: Profile / tuning
docs.text:
--profile controls the DuckDB memory budget per worker (derived from 80% of usable RAM, clamped to a range). Only safe also caps the worker count.

Profile Workers cap Memory fraction Memory range safe max 2 15% of usable RAM 1 – 8 GiB balanced (none) 35% of usable RAM 4 – 24 GiB fast (none) 55% of usable RAM 8 – 32 GiB

Fallback when RAM cannot be detected: safe=2 GiB, balanced=6 GiB, fast=12 GiB.

Use --max-memory-mb to override the profile memory calculation entirely. Workers set via --workers or config are respected unless safe clamps them.

docs.title: Command: download
docs.text:
Sync OpenAlex snapshot from S3 via AWS CLI.

Validation is a separate step via verify_download.

docs.title: Usage
docs.text:
openalex-snapshot download --root-dir /data

Default sync intent:

aws s3 sync --delete s3://openalex /data/openalex-snapshot --no-sign-request

docs.title: Command: extract
docs.text:
Extract records by OpenAlex IDs from CSV using per-dataset parquet indexes.

The command auto-routes each ID to a dataset using:

  • entity prefixes (W, A, S, I, T, K, P, F, G, C)
  • taxonomy namespaces (countries/, continents/, languages/, domains/, fields/, subfields/, sdgs/, work-types/, source-types/, licenses/, institution-types/)

It writes one output file per resolved dataset as:

  • <output_base>_<dataset>.parquet

Unknown/unmapped IDs are skipped and reported.

docs.title: Example
docs.text:
openalex-snapshot extract \
  --root-dir /Volumes/openalex \
  --ids /Volumes/openalex/ids.csv \
  --output /Volumes/openalex/extract.parquet \
  --profile balanced

docs.title: Notes
docs.text:
• Requires per-dataset index files (for example parquet/works_id_idx.parquet).
  • Build indexes first with openalex-snapshot index.
  • Use --dataset <name> to restrict extraction to one dataset.

docs.title: Command: progress
docs.text: Monitor active/recent runs from report/log files, including from another terminal session.

docs.title: Usage
docs.text:
openalex-snapshot progress --root-dir /data
openalex-snapshot progress --root-dir /data --once
openalex-snapshot progress --root-dir /data --command convert --dataset works

docs.title: Notes
docs.text:
• default mode is live watch
  • --once prints one snapshot and exits
  • --json emits machine-readable output

docs.title: Command: prune-reports
docs.text: Remove older report files and keep the latest set.

docs.title: Usage
docs.text: openalex-snapshot prune-reports --root-dir /data

docs.title: Notes
docs.text:
• keeps recent reports and deletes older ones according to command policy
  • use before long-running batches to reduce metadata noise

docs.title: Command: repair_convert
docs.text: Re-convert files that failed in a prior verify_convert report.

docs.title: Usage
docs.text:
openalex-snapshot repair_convert \
  --root-dir /data \
  --dataset works \
  --from-verify-report /data/.openalex-snapshot_metadata/reports/verify_convert-123456.json

docs.title: Behavior
docs.text:
• selects actionable phase=verify_metrics failures
  • deletes failed parquet outputs (if present)
  • re-converts selected sources
  • re-verifies repaired files

docs.title: Command: report
docs.text: Show run reports written under .openalex-snapshot_metadata.

docs.title: Usage
docs.text:
openalex-snapshot report --root-dir /data --latest
openalex-snapshot report --root-dir /data --latest --full

docs.title: Notes
docs.text:
• use --command <name> to filter (for example verify_convert, repair_convert)
  • use --full to print full JSON details

docs.title: Command: schema
docs.text: Inspect schema from source/cache/parquet and optionally diff schema sources.

docs.title: Usage
docs.text:
openalex-snapshot schema \
  --root-dir /data \
  --dataset works \
  --from auto \
  --format arrow-r

docs.title: Notes
docs.text:
• canonical cache: .openalex-snapshot_metadata/datasets/<dataset>/schemata/unified_schema.csv
  • arrow-r format is stable JSON for R Arrow comparisons

docs.title: skills
docs.text: Create a project-local skills/ starter pack for AI coding agents.

docs.title: Usage
docs.text: openalex-snapshot skills --root-dir .

docs.title: Options
docs.text:
• --root-dir <path> root containing snapshot/parquet/metadata layout
  • --overwrite rewrite generated template files
  • --stdout print template manifest/content
  • --explain print planned actions only

docs.title: Behavior
docs.text:
• Default mode is non-destructive: missing files are created, existing files are kept.
  • Generated content focuses on command operation, pipeline runbook, recovery, and docs hygiene.

docs.title: Command: verify_convert
docs.text: Verify snapshot/parquet parity for structure and file-level metrics.

docs.title: Usage
docs.text:
openalex-snapshot verify_convert \
  --root-dir /data \
  --dataset works \
  --scope dataset \
  --metadata-level both

docs.title: Scope
docs.text:
• file: sampled file-pair checks
  • dataset: all files in one dataset
  • snapshot: all selected datasets

docs.title: Metadata levels
docs.text:
• row-count
  • id-hash
  • both

docs.title: Command: verify_download
docs.text: Strictly validate downloaded snapshot integrity.

docs.title: Usage
docs.text: openalex-snapshot verify_download --root-dir /data

docs.title: Checks
docs.text:
• remote manifest parity
  • missing files
  • size mismatches
  • optional extra local files
  • gzip integrity for .json.gz

docs.title: Command: verify_index
docs.text: Verify index integrity and coverage for one dataset or all datasets.

docs.title: Usage
docs.text:
openalex-snapshot verify_index \
  --root-dir /data \
  --dataset all

docs.title: Checks
docs.text:
• required index columns are present
  • referenced parquet files exist
  • row-number references are valid

docs.title: Command: verify_schema
docs.text: Verify schema parity across schema sources.

docs.title: Usage
docs.text:
openalex-snapshot verify_schema \
  --root-dir /data \
  --dataset works \
  --left source \
  --right parquet

docs.title: Notes
docs.text:
• exits non-zero when schema differences are found
  • default comparison is source vs parquet

docs.title: Runbook: Precompute Verify Caches
docs.text:
openalex-snapshot verify_convert \
  --root-dir /data \
  --dataset all \
  --scope snapshot \
  --metadata-level both

docs.title: Runbook: Low-Memory Conversion
docs.text:
openalex-snapshot convert \
  --root-dir /data \
  --dataset works \
  --profile safe \
  --workers 1 \
  --max-memory-mb 4096

Notes: - keep workers low (1) for hard memory constraints - use repeated --input-file to isolate problematic files

docs.title: Resume convert
docs.text: Re-run the same convert command; existing outputs are skipped.

docs.title: Repair failed files
docs.text:
openalex-snapshot repair_convert \
  --root-dir /data \
  --from-verify-report /data/.openalex-snapshot_metadata/reports/verify_convert-<ts>.json

docs.title: Diagnose failures
docs.text:
• openalex-snapshot report --root-dir /data --latest --full
  • openalex-snapshot progress --root-dir /data --once
